ligne-propos: Document icon 24, or External link in its place; type 15/700 grey, title 17/600, pages · size · publisher 15 grey, badges below, chevron. The whole row is the target.
ligne-en-ligne: Online — downloaded and up to date · new and restricted · external link · replaced
ligne-hors-connexion: Offline — what is not on the phone dims and loses its chevron
ligne-note: A replaced or unavailable title turns grey. Without a known total the bar goes away: it would lie about the share received; the words stay. The type comes from the vocabulary served by the API, never from a translation.
extrait: … the global goal on adaptation sets a common framework, which each Party translates into its national plan …
filtre-propos: On the bottom sheet: 56 px check rows with the count on the right, “Show n documents”, “Cancel”. It works on a draft: closing without showing changes nothing.
filtre-note: The button counts what the draft would give before it is applied, zero included.
bandeau-propos: Full width, charter yellow background, Replaced icon 20, title of the current document as a link. The whole banner is the target.
bandeau-note: The second one: the current document is restricted and the account has no access — the line says so instead of its pages.
progression-propos: 6 px line, accent on pale grey: the share received of a download, the share read of a document. Distinct from the gauge, which tells storage space.
progression-note: Without a total, the bar is not shown: it would lie about the share. The nearby text always says it in words; when it already does, the bar stays silent for screen readers.
lecture-propos: At the bottom, within thumb's reach. Collapsed: “Page n of N”, the section, and the share read in 6 px. Expanded: the tab bar's measurements — 68 px, icons 26, labels 13.
lecture-depliee: Expanded — Contents, Search, Settings; tap the text to toggle
lecture-texte: The stakes of the GGA at COP30 are crucial, as the Conference aims to raise adaptation to the same level of centrality as mitigation in the global climate response.
lecture-note: The tap in the middle belongs to the screen; scrolling collapses the bar. No “Bookmark” until its result is designed. With no action offered, the expanded bar shows only the page line.
page-propos: Text reflowed to the screen width: fixed headings, text at the chosen size, English term in underlined italics, footnotes at the end of the page, and a link to the original page for a table or a figure.
page-apres-terme: , GGA) has been negotiated since COP26.
page-note-planche: “See the original page” opens the page image; here it is not kept, and the page says so instead of staying blank.
image-attente: Page image — loading, its space reserved
image-hors: Original page available with a network
